THESEEKER-HARMONY.title: Harmony
THESEEKER-HARMONY.description: Whenever you play an attack after playing a skill, gain 1 temporary dexterity. Whenever you play a skill after playing an attack, gain 1 temporary strength.
THESEEKER-HARMONY.flavor: The inner peace from bla bla something monk you get it.
THESEEKER-SPIKED_HEART.title: Spiked Heart
THESEEKER-SPIKED_HEART.description: Whenever you sacrifice, deal 4 damage to all enemies.
THESEEKER-SPIKED_HEART.flavor: I really didn't think I'd have to create flavor text for all of these.
THESEEKER-ECONOMIC_SACRIFICE.title: Economic Sacrifice
THESEEKER-ECONOMIC_SACRIFICE.description: Whenever you heal, gain the same amount of gold.
THESEEKER-ECONOMIC_SACRIFICE.flavor: Some call it blood money, he just calls it a smart investment.
THESEEKER-REVITALIZE.title: Revitalize
THESEEKER-REVITALIZE.description: Every other turn, gain energy the first time you trigger harmony.
THESEEKER-REVITALIZE.flavor: Going for balance will sometimes grant you exactly what you were missing.
THESEEKER-MALEVOLENT_MANTRA.title: Malevolent Mantra
THESEEKER-MALEVOLENT_MANTRA.description: At the start of your turn, apply 1 disintegrate to all enemies.
THESEEKER-MALEVOLENT_MANTRA.flavor: Imagine if he had a shrine...
THESEEKER-BLOOD_EPIPHANY.title: Blood Epiphany
THESEEKER-BLOOD_EPIPHANY.description: The first time you sacrifice each combat, heal 3 HP.
